issues.display_title: Issue #537: Optimize Performance, Concurrency, and Resource Usage Across API Infrastructure
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Optimize Performance, Concurrency, and Resource Usage Across API Infrastructure

Summary

Refactored critical performance, resource management, and concurrency bottlenecks across src/Middleware/, src/Action/V2/Users/, src/Utils/RabbitMQ/, src/Utils/Redis/, and src/Utils/Functions/:

  1. Redis Logger Middleware:

    • Batched Incr and Expire commands into a single TCP round-trip using Redis Pipeline (rdb.Pipeline()).
    • Added a 250ms deadline timeout context (redisLoggerTimeout) to ensure slow Redis calls never stall HTTP requests.
    • Guarded against nil Redis client pointers to eliminate runtime panics in uninitialized environments.

  2. Regex Precompilation:

    • Swapped dynamic on-the-fly regexp.MatchString in src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile.go with precompiled Patterns.Username and Patterns.FullnameSpecialChars from src/Utils/Patterns.
    • Removed unused "regexp" import from EditProfile.go.

  3. Reused Thread-Safe RabbitMQ Publisher Channel:

    • Replaced per-message AMQP channel creation (conn.Channel() and ch.Close()) in src/Utils/RabbitMQ/RabbitMQ.go with a reusable, mutex-protected channel (pubChannel).
    • Implemented automatic recovery: if channel is closed or publish fails, the channel is closed, invalidated, and reopened with a one-time retry.
    • Invalidates cached publisher channel on connection reconnects.

  4. Redis Cache Nil Guards & Dual Format Decoding:

    • Added nil checks to ReplaceUserDetails, ReplaceDeactiveUser, SuggestionUser, and ListBlockUser in src/Utils/Redis/user_cache.go.
    • In UserDatas (src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go), added a 2-second timeout context and nil check for RedisClient.
    • Intercepted "User Not Found" before base64 decoding to return accurate error payloads.
    • Added dual format decoding to support both base64-encoded JSON and direct raw JSON strings.

  5. Shared Outbound HTTP Client:

    • Replaced zero-timeout http.Get(...) in src/Utils/Functions/response.go with defaultHTTPClient configured with a 10-second timeout.
    • Unified ReCaptcha and ReCaptchaSlim into a shared verifyCaptcha helper.

Files Updated

1. src/Middleware/RedisLogger.go

  • Added const redisLoggerTimeout = 250 * time.Millisecond.
  • Checked if rdb == nil before attaching handler.
  • Converted rdb.Incr + rdb.Expire sequence to rdb.Pipeline().

2. src/Middleware/RedisLogger_test.go

  • Added TestRedisLogger_NilClientDoesNotPanic to verify nil client safety.
  • Added TestRedisLogger_UnreachableClientFailsGracefully to ensure timeout and non-blocking handler execution.

3. src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile.go

  • Replaced regexp.MatchString with Patterns.Username.MatchString and Patterns.FullnameSpecialChars.MatchString.
  • Cleaned up "regexp" import.

4. src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile_test.go

  • Added TestValidLocation with table-driven test cases covering edge cases (spaces, digit-only, control characters, tags, rune boundaries).

5. src/Utils/RabbitMQ/RabbitMQ.go

  • Added pubChannel *amqp.Channel and pubChannelMu sync.Mutex.
  • In GetConnection(), safely closed and cleared pubChannel when reconnecting.
  • In Publish(), reused pubChannel with automatic reconnect retry.

6. src/Utils/RabbitMQ/connection_test.go

  • Added TestPublishUnreachableReturnsError to verify error propagation when connection is unavailable.

7. src/Utils/Redis/user_cache.go

  • Added if RedisClient != nil checks across cache setter operations.

8. src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go

  • Added 2-second timeout context for Redis retrieval.
  • Added nil check for Redis.RedisClient.
  • Implemented direct check for "User Not Found".
  • Added support for both base64-encoded JSON and raw JSON byte slices.

9. src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions_test.go

  • Added TestDecodeUserDetail_Base64AndRawJSON verifying decoding consistency.

10. src/Utils/Functions/response.go

  • Introduced defaultHTTPClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}.
  • Added verifyCaptcha(secret, input string) bool.
  • Updated MakeGetCRULRequest to use defaultHTTPClient.

Verification

  • Lint / Vet:

    go vet ./...
# (no output - passed cleanly)

  • Unit Tests:

    go test -v ./src/Middleware/...
# PASS: TestRedisLogger_NilClientDoesNotPanic
# PASS: TestRedisLogger_UnreachableClientFailsGracefully

go test -v ./src/Action/V2/Users/...
# PASS: TestValidLocation (all subtests passed)

go test -v ./src/Utils/RabbitMQ/...
# PASS: TestDisconnectNilChannelDoesNotPanic
# PASS: TestGetConnectionUnreachableReturnsNil
# PASS: TestPublishUnreachableReturnsError
# PASS: TestPublishJSONMarshalsPayloadAndPreservesQueue
# PASS: TestPublishJSONReturnsMarshalErrorWithoutPublishing
# PASS: TestPublishJSONReturnsPublishError

go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/...
# PASS: TestDecodeUserDetail_Base64AndRawJSON

go test ./...
# All packages across the repository passed.

Problem

Audit of panorra-api-go-new identified several performance bottlenecks, unbounded resources, and latency overheads in core request handling and background messaging paths:

  1. Redis Logger Middleware Overhead:
    Every incoming HTTP request executed two sequential synchronous Redis round-trips (rdb.Incr followed by rdb.Expire) using an unbounded context.Background(). If Redis experienced latency spikes, all API endpoints slowed down. Additionally, if the Redis client was not initialized, it triggered a nil pointer dereference panic.

  2. Repetitive Regex Compilation in Handlers:
    src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile.go compiled regular expressions dynamically via regexp.MatchString on every username and fullname validation, creating unnecessary AST parsing and memory allocation churn instead of leveraging precompiled patterns.

  3. Ephemeral RabbitMQ Publisher Channels:
    RabbitMQ.Publish opened and closed a brand new AMQP channel (conn.Channel() and ch.Close()) on every single published message. This introduced four AMQP network RPC round-trips (channel.open, channel.open-ok, channel.close, channel.close-ok) per event.

  4. Redis Cache Handling & Panic Vulnerabilities:
    UserDatas in UsersFunctions.go retrieved user caches using an unbounded context.Background() with no nil check on RedisClient. In addition, if user lookup failed, ReplaceUserDetails returned "User Not Found", which caused base64.DecodeString to fail with a confusing "Error decoding base64" message. Multiple Redis write helpers also lacked nil guards.

  5. Unbounded Outbound HTTP Requests:
    ReCaptcha, ReCaptchaSlim, and MakeGetCRULRequest in src/Utils/Functions/response.go relied on standard http.Get(...) which uses http.DefaultClient with zero timeout. If external services hung or stalled, Fiber worker goroutines leaked indefinitely.

Scope

  1. Middleware:

    • src/Middleware/RedisLogger.go: Implement Redis pipelining (Incr + Expire in one TCP round-trip), 250ms context timeout, and nil-client guard.
    • src/Middleware/RedisLogger_test.go: Add unit tests for nil client handling and unreachable Redis graceful fallback.

  2. V2 Profile Actions:

    • src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile.go: Replace dynamic regexp.MatchString calls with precompiled Patterns.Username and Patterns.FullnameSpecialChars.
    • src/Action/V2/Users/EditProfile_test.go: Add unit tests covering location validation and string constraint boundaries.

  3. Messaging (RabbitMQ):

    • src/Utils/RabbitMQ/RabbitMQ.go: Maintain a thread-safe, mutex-guarded cached publisher channel (pubChannel) with automatic recovery and retry upon channel closure.
    • src/Utils/RabbitMQ/connection_test.go: Verify unreachable connection error handling when publishing.

  4. Caching & User Helpers:

    • src/Utils/Redis/user_cache.go: Add nil guards to ReplaceUserDetails, ReplaceDeactiveUser, SuggestionUser, and ListBlockUser.
    • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go: Add 2s context timeout, nil guard, direct handling of "User Not Found", and backward-compatible support for both base64 and raw JSON cache entries.
    • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions_test.go: Add unit tests for decoding user details across base64 and raw JSON formats.

  5. HTTP Utilities:

    • src/Utils/Functions/response.go: Introduce shared defaultHTTPClient with a 10-second timeout, consolidating captcha verification logic into a unified verifyCaptcha helper.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible: No modifications to route paths, query/body contracts, response envelope structures, or status codes.
  • Fault-Tolerant: External dependency failures (Redis/RabbitMQ/HTTP timeouts) degrade gracefully rather than hanging or panicking the server.

Acceptance Criteria

  • NewRedisLogger pipelines commands into a single round-trip and gracefully handles nil/unreachable Redis clients.
  • EditProfile uses precompiled patterns from src/Utils/Patterns.
  • RabbitMQ.Publish reuses an active channel safely across concurrent goroutines.
  • UserDatas handles nil Redis, applies a 2s timeout, and decodes both base64 and raw JSON.
  • ReCaptcha and HTTP requests use an HTTP client with a strict 10s timeout.
  • go vet ./... passes with zero warnings.
  • go test ./... passes across the entire project.

Delivery

Implemented on 2026-10-06.

issues.display_title: Issue #538: Refactor Stability and Quick Wins (Crash Prevention & Runtime Guards)
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Stability and Quick Wins (Crash Prevention & Runtime Guards)

Summary

Completed critical stability hardening across the entire API server and worker processes:

  1. Eliminated log.Fatal / log.Fatalln in HTTP Handlers & Post Utilities:
    Replaced all process-killing log.Fatal calls with graceful error logs and standard Fiber error responses across src/Action/V1/Users/EditProfile.go, src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPost.go, src/Action/V1/Posts/DeletePost.go, src/Action/V1/Additional/UpdateDraftImage.go, src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/image_signing.go, and src/Utils/Functions/BroadcastFunctions/BroadcastFunctions.go. Temporary S3/MinIO downtime or notification failure no longer crashes the running application.

  2. Fixed Package-Scope var prefix = os.Getenv("PREFIX") Initialization:
    Eliminated package-level var prefix declarations that evaluated before .env files were loaded at startup across Bookmarks, Comments, Additional, Notifications, Auth, Cronjob, and Users. Updated calls to query os.Getenv("PREFIX") dynamically at runtime. Ensured ElasticSearch.InitElastic() re-evaluates os.Getenv("ELASTICSEARCH_ADDRESS") upon client initialization.

  3. Fixed RabbitMQ Worker Double-ACK & Infinite Requeue Loops:
    Corrected message consumption order in UserSlim.go, PublishPanorraGD360.go, UploadPanorama.go, PostSubscribe.go, and RemoveGD360.go. Moved defer delivery.Ack(false) to execute only after message payload validation succeeds, and replaced delivery.Reject(true) on bad JSON with _ = delivery.Reject(false) to prevent infinite requeue loops.

  4. Corrected Configuration Typos & Bootstrapping Fallbacks:
    Fixed CORR_ALLOW_METHOD typo in cmd/main.go to CORS_ALLOW_METHOD (with backward-compatible fallback) and added local .env file fallback so the server starts smoothly across local, Docker, and production environments.

  5. Hardened Crypto Functions Against Panics:
    Replaced all log.Fatal invocations in EncryptResultV1 with proper returned Go errors. Added string and submatch slice bounds checking to KeyEncrypt and KeyEncryptV1 to prevent index out of range panics.

Files Updated

1. HTTP Handlers & Post Utilities

  • src/Action/V1/Users/EditProfile.go: Replaced log.Fatalln in MinIO client init and upload with graceful 500 error responses and warning logs for old avatar deletion.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPost.go: Replaced 4 log.Fatalln blocks in MinIO client init and bucket uploads with graceful 500 error responses.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/DeletePost.go: Replaced log.Fatalln in single and multiple post MinIO file deletions with warning logs; added bounds checks on split path slices.
  • src/Action/V1/Additional/UpdateDraftImage.go: Replaced log.Fatalln in MinIO client init, dimension parsing, and S3 uploads with logging and graceful continuation.
  • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/image_signing.go: Replaced log.Fatalf and log.Fatalln in ProcessThumbnail with error response map returns.
  • src/Utils/Functions/BroadcastFunctions/BroadcastFunctions.go: Replaced 12 log.Fatalf calls in BroadcastMobile and BroadcastWeb with log.Printf and error/empty string returns.

2. Crypto & Functions

  • src/Utils/Functions/crypto.go:
    • Replaced all 6 log.Fatal calls in EncryptResultV1 with typed errors.
    • Added bounds checking in KeyEncrypt and KeyEncryptV1 for matches slice length and encrypt minimum length.
  • src/Utils/Functions/encrypt_response_test.go:
    • Added TestKeyEncrypt_InvalidInputs and TestEncryptResultV1_InsufficientData.

3. Prefix Dynamic Evaluation

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/bookmark_helpers.go: Removed package-level var prefix; evaluated at runtime in deleteFolderElastic.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/comment_helpers.go: Removed package-level var prefix; evaluated at runtime in bulk delete.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/DeleteComment.go: Replaced prefix with os.Getenv("PREFIX").
  • src/Action/V1/Additional/ChangeUsername.go: Replaced prefix with os.Getenv("PREFIX").
  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/PushNotification.go: Removed unused package-level var prefix.
  • src/Action/V1/Auth/helpers.go: Removed redundant package-level var prefix.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationYoutube.go: Replaced prefix with os.Getenv("PREFIX").
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteElasticSearch.go: Evaluated prefix at runtime before delete iteration.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/UpdateElasticSearch.go: Evaluated prefix at runtime.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteUser.go: Replaced prefix with os.Getenv("PREFIX").
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationTourmkr.go: Replaced prefix with os.Getenv("PREFIX").
  • src/Action/V1/Users/SetAllListUserOnRedis.go: Replaced prefix with os.Getenv("PREFIX").
  • src/Action/V1/Users/otp_helpers.go: Replaced prefix with os.Getenv("PREFIX").
  • src/Action/V1/Users/social_helpers.go: Removed unused package-level var prefix.
  • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticSearch.go: Dynamically checks os.Getenv("ELASTICSEARCH_ADDRESS") in initElastic().

4. RabbitMQ Workers

  • src/Worker/UserSlim/UserSlim.go: Defers Ack only after payload unmarshal; rejects without requeue (Reject(false)) on bad JSON; safely validates fields.
  • src/Worker/PublishPanorraGD360/PublishPanorraGD360.go: Defers Ack only after payload unmarshal; rejects without requeue on bad JSON.
  • src/Worker/UploadPanorama/UploadPanorama.go: Defers Ack only after payload unmarshal; rejects without requeue on base64/JSON decode failure.
  • src/Worker/PostSubscribe/PostSubscribe.go: Defers Ack only after payload unmarshal; rejects without requeue on bad JSON.
  • src/Worker/RemoveGD360/RemoveGD360.go: Defers Ack only after payload unmarshal; rejects without requeue on bad JSON.

5. Server Bootstrap

  • cmd/main.go:
    • Corrected CORR_ALLOW_METHOD to CORS_ALLOW_METHOD with fallback support.
    • Loaded /home/config/panorra-api-new/env.<stage> with local ./env.<stage> fallback, failing fast if the file is not found.

6. Ansible Deployment

  • ansible-deploy.yml:
    • Uncommented worker build and transfer steps (Build Workers App and Copy build workers folder to toronto).
    • Uncommented Restart Workers targeting strictly the 5 modified workers (development-PublishPanorraGD360, development-UploadPanorama, development-UserSlim, development-PostSubscribe, and development-RemoveGD360) with count: 1.

Verification

  • Vet:

    go vet ./...
# PASS (0 warnings / 0 errors)

  • Tests:

    go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions -run "TestKeyEncrypt_InvalidInputs|TestEncryptResultV1_InsufficientData"
# PASS: TestKeyEncrypt_InvalidInputs
# PASS: TestEncryptResultV1_InsufficientData

go test ./...
# All packages across repository passed cleanly

Problem

Audit of panorra-api-go-new identified critical operational risks where server processes and background workers terminate abruptly or corrupt state:

  1. Process-Killing log.Fatal in HTTP Request Handlers & Utilities:
    log.Fatal / log.Fatalln calls os.Exit(1). In HTTP handlers (src/Action/V1/Users/EditProfile.go, AddPost.go, DeletePost.go, UpdateDraftImage.go) and utilities (image_signing.go, crypto.go, BroadcastFunctions.go), temporary MinIO network hiccups, bad signing keys, or notification dispatch failures terminate the entire running API server process.

  2. Package-Level var prefix = os.Getenv("PREFIX") Initialization Bug:
    Multiple packages (Bookmarks, Comments, Additional, Notifications, Auth, Cronjob, ElasticSearch) declare var prefix = os.Getenv("PREFIX") at package scope. These are evaluated before main() executes and before godotenv.Load() reads .env files. As a consequence, prefix is evaluated as empty (""), causing Elasticsearch indices to be constructed incorrectly (e.g., folder_bookmarks_ instead of folder_bookmarks_live).

  3. Double-ACK / Reject-then-Ack & Requeue Loops in RabbitMQ Workers:
    In UserSlim.go, PublishPanorraGD360.go, UploadPanorama.go, PostSubscribe.go, and RemoveGD360.go, defer delivery.Ack(false) is set at the top of message consumers, followed by delivery.Reject(true) on JSON unmarshal errors. When return executes, the deferred Ack runs, causing an AMQP protocol violation. Furthermore, Reject(true) on malformed payloads creates an infinite requeue loop.

  4. Environment Typos & Server Bootstrap Hardcoding:
    cmd/main.go reads os.Getenv("CORR_ALLOW_METHOD") (typo for CORS_ALLOW_METHOD) and unconditionally panics if /home/config/panorra-api-new/ does not exist, preventing local development or containerized execution.

  5. Runtime Bounds Vulnerability in Crypto Key Generation:
    KeyEncrypt and KeyEncryptV1 in crypto.go access regex submatches without validating that the regex matched, causing runtime panics on unexpected date formats.

Scope

  1. HTTP Action Handlers & Post Utilities:

    • src/Action/V1/Users/EditProfile.go: Replace log.Fatalln with graceful error logging and responses.
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPost.go: Replace log.Fatalln in all 4 MinIO upload blocks with graceful error responses.
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/DeletePost.go: Replace log.Fatalln in MinIO deletion blocks with graceful warning logging.
    • src/Action/V1/Additional/UpdateDraftImage.go: Replace log.Fatalln with graceful logging and error returns.
    • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/image_signing.go: Replace log.Fatalf / log.Fatalln with graceful error map responses.
    • src/Utils/Functions/BroadcastFunctions/BroadcastFunctions.go: Replace log.Fatalf with log.Printf and error responses.

  2. Crypto & Response Helpers:

    • src/Utils/Functions/crypto.go: Replace log.Fatal in EncryptResultV1 with returned Go errors. Add bounds check on regex submatch slices in KeyEncrypt and KeyEncryptV1.

  3. Prefix Evaluation Fixes:

    • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/bookmark_helpers.go
    • src/Action/V1/Comments/comment_helpers.go
    • src/Action/V1/Additional/ChangeUsername.go
    • src/Action/V1/Notifications/PushNotification.go
    • src/Action/V1/Auth/helpers.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationYoutube.go
    • src/Action/V1/Users/social_helpers.go
    • src/Utils/ElasticSearch/ElasticSearch.go (initElastic)

  4. RabbitMQ Worker Safety:

    • src/Worker/UserSlim/UserSlim.go
    • src/Worker/PublishPanorraGD360/PublishPanorraGD360.go
    • src/Worker/UploadPanorama/UploadPanorama.go
    • src/Worker/PostSubscribe/PostSubscribe.go
    • src/Worker/RemoveGD360/RemoveGD360.go

  5. Bootstrap & Configuration:

    • cmd/main.go: Correct CORR_ALLOW_METHOD to CORS_ALLOW_METHOD (with backward-compatible fallback) and support local env.<stage> fallback without swallowing missing environment errors.

Behavior Boundary

  • Zero Downtime / Zero Crash: Transient storage, notification, or messaging errors return standard HTTP 500 error responses rather than crashing the process.
  • 100% Backward Compatible: Preserves exact route signatures, headers, contracts, and encryption formulas.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Zero calls to log.Fatal* within HTTP handlers or utility libraries.
  • All worker consumers perform safe acknowledgement without double-ACK or infinite requeue loops.
  • ElasticSearch.InitElastic() and helpers read os.Getenv("PREFIX") at runtime.
  • cmd/main.go reads CORS_ALLOW_METHOD and supports fallback env loading.
  • go vet ./... passes cleanly with zero warnings.
  • go test ./... passes across the entire project.

Delivery

Implemented on 2026-10-06.
